title: You Pull a Switch to Save Five Lives, Yet Your Brain Refuses to Push One Man
description:
You would pull a lever to save five lives, yet refuse to push one man! Yet both choices trade one life for five with identical math! This is the true story of Joshua Greene's Trolley Dilemma Study. Here is what went wrong with centuries of philosophy.
